notes: Prospective randomised trial at Foshan Fosun Chancheng Hospital, Guangdong, China (January 2022 to March 2023); 100 children and adolescents aged 8-18 years with progressive myopia (SER -1.00 to -6.00 D), 50 randomised per group.

Primary outcomes analysed by intention to treat with last observation carried forward; the article does not report how many participants were lost or imputed. The tabulated means are raw (not model-adjusted).
Times as tabulated: baseline, 1, 3, 6 and 12 months of treatment.
Device: IOLMaster 700 (Carl Zeiss Meditec). Units: millimetres (column label 'Axial Length (mm)').

Spherical equivalent, BCVA, contrast sensitivity, pupil diameter, corneal epithelial and total thickness, endothelial cell count, corneal biomechanics, tear film and intraocular pressure are tabulated and not extracted.
The Results text and Table 1 disagree on one Group A covariate unrelated to axial length (BMI); noted only as a reporting inconsistency.
